title: About Display ads and the Google Display Network - Google Ads Help

facts.fact: Google's own page says Display campaigns can reach people worldwide across 35 million websites and apps, plus Google-owned properties such as YouTube and Gmail.
facts.quote: Display campaigns can reach people worldwide across 35 million websites and apps, and on Google-owned properties (YouTube and Gmail).

facts.fact: Optimized targeting is the default targeting method for Google Display campaigns, and advertisers can select a different targeting method instead.
facts.quote: Optimized targeting is set as the default targeting method for your Display campaigns. If you prefer not to use optimized targeting, you can select a different form of targeting.

facts.fact: Advertisers can choose to pay for conversions instead of clicks on Display campaigns that use Target CPA bidding, by selecting Conversions under the 'Pay for' header in the Bidding section.
facts.quote: You can pay for conversions, instead of clicks on Display campaigns that use Target CPA bidding.

facts.fact: Google says advertisers can use its library of images for Responsive display ads at no cost.
facts.quote: You can also use our library of images at no cost.

facts.fact: Google states that Smart Display campaigns were integrated into the standard Display campaign offering, and existing Smart Display campaigns migrated automatically without any action required from advertisers.
facts.quote: Any existing Smart Display campaigns in your account will have migrated to this unified Display campaign structure without any action needed on your part.

facts.fact: Google states that migrating Smart Display campaigns to the unified Display campaign structure should not cause fluctuations in campaign performance.
facts.quote: This migration shouldn't cause any fluctuations in your campaign's performance.

facts.fact: Google defines Smart bidding as bidding that uses AI to optimize for conversions or conversion value in each auction.
facts.quote: Bidding that uses AI to optimize for conversions or conversion value in each and every auction.

facts.fact: Google states that uploaded Display ads can be created as images in different sizes or as HTML5.
facts.quote: You can upload ads as images in different sizes or HTML5.

facts.fact: Changes to bids, budget, or targeting in the Google Display Network can take 12–24 hours to apply and may not show right away.
facts.quote: Changes in the Display Network, such as adjustments to bids, budget, or targeting, can take 12–24 hours to apply and may not show right away.

facts.fact: Major structural changes such as creating a new campaign or bid strategy may display a temporary "Learning" status for up to 7 days.
facts.quote: Major structural changes, like creating a new campaign or bid strategy, may display a temporary "Learning" status for up to 7 days.

facts.fact: When there are multiple changes made within a 24 hour period, they may be applied outside of the chronological order of change history.
facts.quote: When there are multiple changes made within a 24 hour period, they may be applied outside of the chronological order of change history.

facts.fact: Reactivating a Display campaign that has been paused for an extended period restarts the learning phase.
facts.quote: If your campaign has been paused for an extended period, reactivating it will also restart the learning phase.
